title: The three recoveries
prompt:
1. `static CompletableFuture<String> recovered()` — async throwing IllegalStateException;
recover with `exceptionally` returning "fallback".
2. `static CompletableFuture<String> handled()` — same failing async; recover with
`handle` returning "fallback" on error, "ok:" + result on success.
3. `static CompletableFuture<String> observed()` — a SUCCEEDING async ("value"), with
`whenComplete` appending to a `static List<String> observations` (add "saw-value" on
success) — return the future; the observation must exist after join.
4. `static CompletableFuture<String> onTimeoutFallback()` — async sleeping 200ms then
returning "late"; bound with `completeOnTimeout("fast-fail", 20, MILLISECONDS)`.

tests.name: each combinator does its one job
